scope_notes: Application fields, calculations, persistence, isolation and supported workflow behavior were tested against the current supplied forms. This is software regression verification, not legal or regulatory certification.
Live checks were read-only apart from sign-in/sign-out and private backup export. Destructive, password, publication and submission scenarios ran against disposable local accounts.
Cold-load timings are observations from four fresh browser contexts on this connection, not a throughput/load-test guarantee.
Original signature and Terms & Conditions PDFs intentionally retain their source layouts.
